استنطقت (form X)
# اِسْتَنْطَقْتُ (istanṭaqtu) /is.tan.tˤaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# اِسْتَنْطَقْتَ (istanṭaqta) /is.tan.tˤaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# اِسْتَنْطَقْتِ (istanṭaqti) /is.tan.tˤaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَنْطَقَ (istanṭaqa)
# اِسْتَنْطَقَتْ (istanṭaqat) /i
